 By Richard Tribou | rtribou@orlandosentinel.com | Orlando Sentinel PUBLISHED: November 5, 2026 at 10:48 AM EST | UPDATED: November 5, 2026 at 10:56 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Universal Orlando announced Thursday it will construct a new indoor roller coaster at its newest park Epic Universe.
 The thrill coaster will be located within the Dark Universe section of the park adjacent to the Monsters Unchained: The Frankenstein Experiment attraction.
 While rumors have long hinted at a Creature from the Black Lagoon attraction, the theme of the new coaster has yet to be announced.
 It will “immerse guests in an all-new story inspired by the iconic Universal Monsters franchise,” according to a press release.
 While construction has already begun, its opening is “planned in the years ahead.”
 Epic Universe opened in 2025, laid out with five themed lands, including this one dedicated to the movie studios’ horror franchises. Other lands are themed to Nintendo, Harry Potter, the “How to Train Your Dragon” film franchise and one named Celestial Park with star-themed attractions.
 It joined Universal Orlando’s original Florida theme park Universal Studios, which opened in 1990, Islands of Adventure, which opened in 1999 and its water park Volcano Bay, which opened in 2017.
 The new monsters-themed coaster is the latest of several upcoming features coming among the parks.
 They include a reworked Universal Horror Make-Up Show featuring Blumhouse at the main Universal Studios park, along with high-speed roller coaster Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift coming next year.
 Islands of Adventure will have a new Jurassic Park-themed, full-service restaurant in 2027 while the shopping and dining district Universal CityWalk will be getting Luke Combs’ Category 10, a music and entertainment venue.
